theme: A caregiving day around Mike's scans, closing with a late call to Tokyo.
greeting: Most of today orbits Mike — the throat ultrasound is behind you and the brain MRI is this afternoon, with tomorrow's surgery to prep for. A haircut and an 8pm call with Jomon in Tokyo round out the edges.

needsAttention.title: Last calls before Mike's surgery
needsAttention.detail: Oral surgery is tomorrow in Portland, so today is the day to fill the prescriptions, stock soft food and ice packs, and lock the ride home. The prep task in Personal Tasks has been sitting since Aug 14.

needsAttention.title: RSVP to the NACD New England reception
needsAttention.detail: Lisa at NACD New England asked you to reply about the Sept 15 Appreciation Reception — exactly the kind of room worth being in for the board search.

schedule.title: Jomon Associates call
schedule.detail: Zoom to Tokyo — morning of Aug 20 there

flagged.title: Amra at BlackRock wrote back
flagged.detail: She replied warmly to your Sustainalytics note and asked after the summer — worth closing the loop while it's warm.

flagged.title: VP, Government Relations role posted
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert flagged a stealth VP of Government Relations & Public Policy opening in your lane.

flagged.title: Maine ferry tickets confirmed
flagged.detail: Your Maine State Ferry reservation to Vinalhaven came through.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — Responsible Investor, NYT Cooking, BoatUS, Amex, and a few Maine locals.
inbox.clear: Nothing hostile in the inbox; no security or account issues needing you.

resolved.title: Bunkers invoice settled
resolved.detail: You paid the $412 Bunkers invoice to Shelby this morning and QuickBooks confirmed it — done.

resolved.title: School follow-up handed back to Mike
resolved.detail: You wrote back on the Karla Reynolds note asking to confirm the details with Nora; the ball's in Mike's court now.

recipe.title: Canal house year-round caprese salad
recipe.why: Late-summer tomatoes and basil are at their peak right now, so a caprese lets them do all the talking.

acts.line: The throat ultrasound with Mike at 9:30 is already behind you.
A 3:30 brain MRI, then a 5 o'clock haircut before the day turns.
An 8pm call with Jomon Associates catches Tokyo's Thursday morning.
